data.body:
## This defect does not exist on `origin/main`. It is confined to an unpushed local commit.

Reproduced the symptom, then located it. The broken recipe is not in the merged tree.

### Where the defect actually is

The shared main checkout `/Users/joeoakhart/rebar` sits on unpushed local commit
`7b92d821718132c92b2ec32dd2c7a76978df47c0`, "Default make worktree to ~/worktrees/rebar/<branch>",
which was committed directly to local main deliberately bypassing Gerrit and the commit gate. Its
`Makefile` reads:

```
239  \t@set -e; \\
240  \t@# Default is ~/worktrees/rebar/<branch>, NOT a sibling of the checkout.
```

Line 239 ends in a continuation, so make joins line 240 onto it and the shell receives
`set -e; @# Default is ~/worktrees/rebar/<branch>, NOT a sibling of the checkout.`, in which
`<branch>` parses as an input redirect. That produces the reported
`/bin/sh: branch: No such file or directory` for every invocation regardless of arguments.

`origin/main` at `c4c07028781` has no such line. Its recipe closes the usage guard with a bare
`fi`, then carries the Bug 1738 comment block as its own unjoined lines, then opens the body with
`@set -e; \` continuing correctly into `target_dir=...`. `set -e` is therefore joined to the body
and Bug 1738's protection is attached, not stranded.

### Functional proof

`make worktree name=probe-8c79-functional` run from a worktree checked out at `c4c07028781`:

```
→ git fetch origin
→ git worktree add .rebar/worktrees/probe-8c79-functional -b probe-8c79-functional origin/main
Preparing worktree (new branch 'probe-8c79-functional')
HEAD is now at c4c07028781 tests: skip semaphore-denied multiprocessing cases
→ provisioning .rebar/worktrees/probe-8c79-functional/.venv (pinned Python) then canonical 'make install'
Using CPython 3.12.14
Installed 116 packages in 274ms
```

It fetched, created the worktree, and provisioned the venv. The probe worktree and its branch were
removed afterwards. The target works.

### Consequence for this ticket

The planned remedy — rejoining `set -e` to the recipe body and relocating the comments in the
`Makefile` — has nothing to apply to. The merged `Makefile` is already correct, having been fixed
by change 2977 for `9b4a-89fb-3328-497e`, which is MERGED with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
The `file_impact` declared here (`Makefile`, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and a new recipe test)
would re-edit a tree that does not carry the defect.

What remains genuinely open is the disposition of `7b92d821718`, which is superseded by 2977 and is
the sole carrier of this defect. Removing it from local main removes the bug. Held for an operator
decision rather than acted on, because it is an unpushed commit on the shared checkout.

No plan review was started against this plan, so nothing was spent discovering the above.

### Method note for successors

`make -n worktree` does NOT dry-run this target. The recipe contains `$(MAKE)`, and make executes
recipe lines containing `$(MAKE)` even under `-n`. A `make -n` "syntax check" of it really runs
`git fetch` and `git worktree add`. Check the recipe by reading the `Makefile` text, or accept the
side effects and clean them up.
